gaps.lead: He started playing golf at the age of six.
gaps.sentence: He ___ golf at the age of six.
gaps.explanation: take up = start (a hobby/sport): took up golf.

gaps.lead: The train takes two hours to get there; the plane takes thirty minutes.
gaps.explanation: twice as fast as = half the time of.

gaps.lead: It was unfair of the referee to send him off.
gaps.explanation: shouldn't have + participle criticises a past action.

gaps.lead: You can't park here — it's forbidden.
gaps.explanation: mustn't = it is forbidden (not: don't have to).

gaps.lead: He finally managed to solve the puzzle.
gaps.explanation: manage to do = be able to do.

gaps.lead: 'I'm sorry I shouted at you,' he said.
gaps.explanation: apologise for doing something: apologised for shouting.
